objective: Prove: (1) a knot on three Boolean distinctions is a hole at its own scope, in the complex of partial solutions, exactly when it excludes two or more states, so the plain hole criterion certifies only level 2 on parity, sum-mod-3 and not-all-equal networks; (2) a charge network over Z_p is refuted at level 3 over any ring of characteristic p and over Z; (3) over any ring in which p is invertible, the level-k affine relaxation of a Z_p charge network on a connected graph is infeasible exactly when k is at least the toggle width, whatever the charges, with an integer refutation certificate at that level and an explicit solution below it. Check each part with certificates verified by substitution.
status: Proved by DEEP-HOLES-20261020-001B-P001 (prose; certificates built and verified by substitution on the 30 census networks and all 19 connected cubic graphs with 10 vertices; six broken certificates rejected; the census agrees). For a Z_p charge network with nonzero total charge: every knot excluding two or more states is a hole at its own scope (rank |E|-1 for Boolean knots), so the plain hole criterion certifies only level 2; rings of characteristic p and Z refute at the size of a star (3 on cubic graphs); every field where p is invertible refutes exactly at the toggle width, whatever the charges, by an integer sweep certificate, with a closed-form Fourier solution one level below. On cubic graphs the monotone toggle width is cutwidth + 1 (proved); the toggle width equals it on all 27 graphs with 4-10 vertices. One 10-vertex graph has depth 6 while its variable graph has treewidth 4.
title: The depth of a charge hole
